reviews.review:
I would say this game has potential but a few things such as the clanker being able to kill you during the beginning of the tutorial and maybe the few times that I had to hide for a pretty long time are some of the few cons that I could think of. When it came to the long times I had to hide it was mostly because I had a hard time telling where the robot was. Not sure if the game was bugging out lol with how fast I was going during update 2 with the person talking on the computer. With the long hide times I pretty much stayed under the couch for a lot of the game since it was pretty hard to tell where this dude was since sometimes you hear footsteps leaving a room and sometimes you don't 

Overall I would say this game has a good concept but needs some work. Besides what I mentioned before the game is pretty difficult mostly related to to clanker roaming around ready to strangle you since from what I can see on the achievements most people didn't beat the game. I feel like the game needs a bit more polish before it can be decent however.
